title: Most church plants don't fail because of bad vision.
paragraphs: Most church plants don't fail because of bad vision.
They fail because nobody taught them how to build the right team.
Let that sink in.
Too many leaders are trying to carry a God-sized mission by themselves.

They have passion.
They have a calling.
They have a burden for souls.
But they don't have a healthy, united, Gospel-centered team.

And eventually...
they burn out.
